news.Title: SonoTek (SOTK) Moves 18.5% Higher: Will This Strength Last?
news.Content:
Sono-Tek Corporation SOTK shares rallied 18.5% in the last trading session to close at $5.9. This move can be attributable to notable volume with a higher number of shares being traded than in a typical session. This compares to the stock's 0.6% gain over the past four weeks.

Sono-Tek Corporation is benefiting from rising adoption of its ultrasonic coating systems across clean energy applications, supported by expanding production-scale orders and a growing backlog.

This company is expected to post quarterly earnings of $0.05 per share in its upcoming report, which represents a year-over-year change of +66.7%. Revenues are expected to be $5.68 million, up 10.1% from the year-ago quarter.

Earnings and revenue growth expectations certainly give a good sense of the potential strength in a stock, but empirical research shows that trends in earnings estimate revisions are strongly correlated with near-term stock price movements.

For SonoTek, the consensus EPS estimate for the quarter has remained unchanged over the last 30 days. And a stock's price usually doesn't keep moving higher in the absence of any trend in earnings estimate revisions. So, make sure to keep an eye on SOTK going forward to see if this recent jump can turn into more strength down the road.

The stock currently carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) stocks here >>>>

SonoTek is a member of the Zacks Electronics - Semiconductors industry. One other stock in the same industry, GlobalFoundries Inc. GFS, finished the last trading session 0.1% higher at $47.92. GFS has returned 9% over the past month.

For GlobalFoundries, the consensus EPS estimate for the upcoming report has changed +0.1% over the past month to $0.51. This represents a change of +24.4% from what the company reported a year ago. GlobalFoundries currently has a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

news.Title: EVgo Eyes 17,000 Stalls by 2030 as Tesla Deal Expands Its EV Charging Reach
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in EVgo Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

EVgo plans to expand significantly , targeting more than 17,000 charging stalls across over 2,000 U.S. locations by 2030, up from approximately 5,500 stalls today.

The Tesla partnership and expanded NACS compatibility could effectively double EVgo's addressable market by enabling easier access for Tesla drivers and adding Tesla-built V4 Superchargers to EVgo's network.

EVgo projects up to $500 million in EBITDA by 2030 , supported by rising EV adoption, higher charger utilization, growing rideshare demand, improved charging margins and long-term site-host partnerships.

EVgo's 37% Revenue Growth: Forget the Car, Buy the Gas Station

EVgo (NASDAQ:EVGO) Chief Executive Officer Badar Khan outlined the fast-charging operator's network expansion, Tesla partnership and long-term profitability targets during the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference.

Khan said EVgo is the third-largest fast-charging operator in the United States and operates an owner-operator model, generating recurring revenue from charging sessions rather than primarily selling equipment. The company focuses on public fast charging in urban locations.

→ AST SpaceMobile's New Securities Lawsuit Adds Fuel to an Already Volatile Stock

EV Charging Solutions: GM's Move Reflects Industry Challenges

EVgo operates about 5,500 charging stalls across 1,200 locations in 47 states, according to Khan. The company has expanded its operating stall count roughly fourfold over the past five years, while revenue has grown about 19-fold from 2021, when it became a public company, through its current-year guidance.

Network Scale and Utilization

Khan said roughly half of EVgo's operating stalls, or stalls expected to be in operation by year-end, have been deployed during the past three years. The company expects to have more than 17,000 stalls at over 2,000 locations by 2030, representing 2.3 gigawatts of connected distributed capacity across U.S. utilities.

→ Akamai's Anthropic Deal Puts $5.5 Billion Behind Its Edge AI Pivot

The Squeeze Is On For EVGo, Rally To Follow

He said EVgo's network recorded approximately 20% utilization in the second quarter, which he described as about five times the average utilization of other fast-charging companies. Khan characterized utilization as a key metric for infrastructure profitability because it measures the share of time chargers are in use.

About two-thirds of EVgo's chargers are 350-kilowatt machines, up from approximately 15% four years ago, Khan said. He stated that a 350-kilowatt charger can provide about 100 miles of driving range in five to 10 minutes.

Story Continues

Tesla Supercharger Agreement Expands Addressable Market

→ Why 3 Struggling Stocks Are Suddenly Spending Big on Buybacks

EVgo recently announced an agreement under which Tesla will build and sell Superchargers to EVgo. The chargers will be owned and branded by EVgo, while EVgo will receive revenue from customer charging sessions, Khan said.

The planned installations will use Tesla's V4 Superchargers, which Khan said are capable of delivering up to 500 kilowatts of charging power. The chargers will also be visible through Tesla's in-vehicle navigation system.

Khan said EVgo's historical revenue growth has come largely from serving non-Tesla vehicles, even though Tesla vehicles represent more than half of EVs on U.S. roads. Tesla drivers can currently charge at EVgo stations with adapters, but the Supercharger installations will not require adapters.

The company also expects to retrofit about 500 of its more than 5,000 stalls with North American Charging Standard, or NACS, cables by the end of the year. EVgo aims to equip all sites built since 2023—about two-thirds of its sites—with NACS cables. Khan said the Tesla relationship and broader NACS deployment could effectively double EVgo's addressable market.

New Technology and Site-Host Partnerships

EVgo has also introduced a next-generation charging architecture with 750-kilowatt peak charging power. Khan said the platform redesign encompasses station layouts, dispensers, user interfaces, firmware and software, drawing on the company's experience from millions of charging sessions. The new architecture is expected to begin rolling out over the next 12 months.

On the site-host side, EVgo recently announced multiyear partnerships with retail real estate investment trusts Brixmor and Regency. The agreements are expected to add 1,000 stalls across the two partnerships, Khan said.

He described grocery-anchored shopping centers as a favorable use case for fast charging, noting that the average U.S. household visits grocery stores two or three times per week and spends about 30 minutes at the location. EVgo's leases with these partners typically run 15 to 20 years, he said, and the company is signing leases at roughly three times the rate of the prior year.

Long-Term Growth and Profitability Outlook

Khan said the growth in EVs on the road remains the primary driver of EVgo's business. He said the U.S. EV fleet has grown approximately fourfold over the last five years, or at a 40% compound annual growth rate. While he noted that S&P's 2030 EV forecast is about 60% below prior forecasts, he said it still implies a doubling of the installed EV base and a 17% compound annual growth rate.

Additional demand drivers include lower-priced EVs attracting drivers without home charging, the expected expiration of leases on 1.5 million EVs over the next three years, and growing electrification among rideshare fleets. Rideshare represented about 10% of EVgo's business previously and now accounts for roughly 30%, Khan said.

EVgo's financial model depends on stall deployment, energy throughput per stall and operating leverage, according to Khan. He said revenue per stall grew about fivefold between 2022 and 2025, while charging margin increased from roughly 15% to about 40% historically. About one-third of charging-margin cost of sales and 60% to two-thirds of general and administrative expenses are fixed, he said.

Khan said EVgo projects up to $500 million in EBITDA by 2030, with potential additional opportunities from autonomous vehicles, acquisitions, geographic expansion and potential monetization of excess utility interconnection capacity. He emphasized that those potential upside items are not included in the company's $500 million EBITDA projection.

About EVgo (NASDAQ:EVGO)

EVgo, Inc operates a public electric vehicle (EV) fast-charging network in the United States. The company develops, owns, and operates charging stations designed primarily for drivers who need to recharge away from home, including at retail centers, grocery stores, parking facilities, and other convenient locations.

EVgo provides charging services through its mobile app and website, which allow customers to locate stations, start charging sessions, and manage payments. The company also offers charging memberships, fleet and rideshare charging solutions, and charging software and services for commercial partners.

news.Title: Apple's smart hub shows its new view of the tech consumer — and its ambition
news.Content:
When just about every tech company is scrambling to come out with new AI-infused hardware, pushing beyond traditional screens, Apple is jumping into an existing product category , but putting on its own spin.

Cupertino is revitalizing its home lineup and going back to what it does best: taking an ambitious view of its grip on customers by cementing new daily habits.

Apple plans to enter the smart-home market on Oct. 13, unveiling a new smart hub with a roughly 6-inch square display, Bloomberg reports . The device can recognize who is approaching it; provide personalized answers; and work as a home dashboard for temperature, locks, music, and video calls.

The expansion of its hardware lineup comes as newly minted CEO John Ternus oversees a push into AI and deeper integration of Apple's delayed Siri AI assistant. Already with an actually updated iPhone and new hardware capabilities, Apple clearly thinks its audience is ready for and open to new devices, and the typically cautious company is doubling down on the moment with the smart hub.

Apple's cautious approach to new gadgets is notable because the tech scene is littered with released-before-its-time flops, including Apple's own Vision Pro headset. In that way, Apple isn't a Google Glass company, willing to risk a misaligned product fit for being first, nor does it follow in OpenAI's footsteps, exploding onto the scene with a software product that wasn't quite ready for primetime.

Long dominated by Google and Amazon, the smart home market represents a major opportunity for Apple, whose HomePod and HomePod mini never took off in the way its other signature hardware has.

The arrival of the new hub also coincides with a new iPhone lineup that, at long last, takes advantage of a revamped Siri and adopts the more casual, language-based way people interact with computers.

In some respects, Apple's late arrival into AI works as an advantage.

While Tech companies like Meta ( META ) and OpenAI ( OPAI.PVT ) are attempting to make AI-native products, using new software as a way for consumers to accept a novel product category, Apple is advancing its AI lineup in reverse. It's integrating a beefed-up Siri into the gadgets and form factors that people already use.

While Apple might be known for refined and intuitive design, its footprint in the consumer world is also defined by attainable prices and universal appeal.

In CarPlay, Apple essentially occupies the driver's seat without ever having to manufacture a vehicle-focused device or execute on its now-forgotten car dreams. And in Apple TV, which will also get a refresh with the first new set-top box since 2022, Apple wedges itself deeper into domestic life, with high-touch, daily use.

Story Continues

Apple is already present in many homes. A home pod showcasing Siri AI gives the company another reason to expand into new and familiar categories of connected products.

"Market share first, AI second" just might be a winning AI strategy.

news.Title: Bill Ackman Sold Alphabet to Buy an AI Stock Down Roughly 20% From Its High. Was That the Right Call?
news.Content:
Hedge fund managers are making big moves to capitalize on the artificial intelligence (AI)-driven stock market gyrations. Billionaire Bill Ackman made some in his portfolio last quarter, completely selling out of Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) (NASDAQ: GOOGL) for his investment fund, Pershing Square . Given the timing of the buys and sells, it is likely that Pershing Square reaped multibagger returns from its investment in Alphabet.

What did Ackman buy with his Google proceeds? He turned to another AI technology giant: Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT). It had been a laggard in the first half of 2026 and was down about 20% from its Q2 highs when Pershing Square topped off its position.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Microsoft is now back near all-time highs and the largest position in the Pershing Square portfolio. Does that mean Ackman made the right move to dump Alphabet for Microsoft?

Microsoft's booming cloud business and software fears

In early 2026, Microsoft's share price was facing two thematic headwinds. First, as the world's largest enterprise software company, Microsoft's stock dipped alongside the rest of the sector amid concerns that AI would disrupt everything.

It turns out that no AI disruption has occurred so far, or that it is taking much longer than pessimists assumed. Microsoft's commercial 365 software revenue rose 14% year over year in constant currency last quarter, showing no signs of disruption from AI.

Second, Microsoft had some weakness relative to other major technology players due to OpenAI's speed bumps in 2026. Previously, Microsoft was the leading cloud provider for OpenAI and was seen as reliant on OpenAI for revenue growth at its Azure cloud business. Microsoft has since diversified its AI cloud business beyond a sole bet on OpenAI, while also securing major commitments from its flagship partner.

Last quarter, Microsoft's cloud revenue increased 27% to $59.3 billion, with remaining performance obligations rising 84% to $678 billion. On these numbers, the stock price has begun to recover and is now down just 5% from the 2025 highs.

A cheap earnings multiple compared to the rest of big tech

Compared with other large technology players such as Alphabet, Microsoft had a much lower valuation in the first half of 2026. Earlier this year, when Pershing Square was buying, Microsoft had a forward price-to-earnings ratio (P/E) in the low 20s. For a business with revenue increasing in double-digit percentages with a huge order backlog, that is a low price, which was driven by the slump across the entire enterprise software sector.

Story Continues

Alphabet's forward P/E ratio was in the low 30s during the same period, while Apple 's was in the high 30s. Pershing Square likely saw Microsoft as a better value because of this discrepancy in earnings ratios.

MSFT PE Ratio (Forward) data by YCharts

Was it the right move?

So far, Ackman's decision to sell Alphabet and buy more Microsoft is looking smart. Alphabet's stock is down 15% since the middle of Q2, while Microsoft shares are up 26% and close to breaking through to new all-time highs.

But what about the long term? Alphabet is no slouch of a business and is growing quickly. Its Google Cloud business is actually growing much faster than Microsoft, posting 82% year-over-year growth to $24.8 billion in Q2.

The one concern investors have with Alphabet right now is the potential disruption of Google Search. People worry that new AI agents like ChatGPT or Claude will take users away from Google, Alphabet's cash cow. Still, these concerns have not shown up in Alphabet's financial performance yet, with Google Search revenue up 17% year over year, which is actually faster than Microsoft's enterprise software revenue growth.

Microsoft may have been a better buy earlier in 2026 because of its cheaper P/E ratio. However, over the long term, if you are comfortable with the AI risks for both businesses, both Alphabet and Microsoft should do fine in your portfolio.

news.Title: Warren Buffett's Successor, Greg Abel, Jettisoned Amazon Earlier This Year and More Than 6X'd Berkshire's Stake in the "Apple" of His Eye
news.Content:
This isn't your grandparents' Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE:BRKA)(NYSE:BRKB) any longer. Following Warren Buffett's Dec. 31 retirement as CEO after more than half a century at the helm, his successor, Greg Abel, was quick to shake up Berkshire's $358 billion investment portfolio.

Buffett's protégé reduced six holdings in the first quarter and sent 16 others to the chopping block , including dual-industry leader Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN). But amid this selling spree, Abel also found the new apple of his eye: Google parent Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL)(NASDAQ:GOOG).

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Warren Buffett retired as Berkshire's CEO on Dec. 31, paving the way for Greg Abel to shake up the investment portfolio. Image source: Getty Images.

Abel sends Amazon packing

Among the 16 stocks sent packing in the March-ended quarter, arguably none was more surprising than Amazon.

Most people become familiar with Amazon due to its e-commerce dominance. Last year, its marketplace accounted for more than 40% of U.S. online retail sales, more than quadrupling its next-closest competitor, Walmart (NASDAQ:WMT).

But Amazon is also the global leader in cloud infrastructure services spend. Before artificial intelligence (AI) became the hottest thing since sliced bread, Amazon Web Services (AWS) was growing in the high teens annually. Since the integration of generative AI and large language model solutions, AWS's year-over-year sales growth surged to 37% in the June-ended quarter.

With everything going so well, you might be wondering why Abel sold. One possibility is simple profit-taking. Although Buffett and Abel are decidedly long-term investors, Amazon's shares had advanced roughly 150% to 200% since Berkshire's initial buy in the first quarter of 2019.

However, the more logical answer may be Todd Combs' departure in December for JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM). Combs had been a key investment manager for Berkshire alongside Ted Weschler. The positions Abel jettisoned in the first quarter were predominantly non-core holdings that Combs oversaw. Selling Amazon stock likely fell under this reasoning.

Image source: Getty Images.

Abel's Alphabet stake has grown by 550%!

On the other hand, Warren Buffett's successor appears to have found his version of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in Google parent Alphabet. Whereas the Oracle of Omaha's appetite for Apple stock was ravenous a decade ago, so is Abel's for shares of Alphabet in 2026. Between Dec. 31 and Sept. 25, Berkshire's stake in Alphabet has grown from $5.59 billion to $36.37 billion.

Story Continues

Just like his predecessor, Abel is a big fan of companies with sustainable moats. Google maintains a virtual monopoly, holding a greater-than-91% share of global internet search in August. When coupled with YouTube, the second-most-visited social site, it's easy to see why Alphabet's ad platforms command top-tier pricing power.

However, it's Alphabet's AI ambitions that really have Abel (and Buffett) excited for the future. The integration of AI solutions into Google Cloud, the world's No. 3 cloud infrastructure services platform, has produced a parabolic increase in sales (82% in the June-ended quarter). As Google Cloud becomes a larger piece of Alphabet's sales, the company's operating cash flow can rapidly grow.

Furthermore, Alphabet is sitting on a mountain of cash to fuel its AI ambitions, and its investment portfolio is packed with truly jaw-dropping returns from the likes of Space Exploration Technologies (SpaceX) (NASDAQ:SPCX) and Anthropic.

news.Title: Microsoft’s Trillion-Dollar Quarter Shows AI Trade Won’t Quit
news.Content:
(Bloomberg) -- With Microsoft Corp.'s best quarter for decades in the books, Wall Street is betting the stock can keep rallying as the tech giant's standing in the artificial intelligence landscape continues to improve.

Most Read from Bloomberg

Apple Is Finally Ready to Enter Its Next Big Category: the Smart Home

Apple's New CEO Seeks to Make Company Run Faster and Leaner

Google Grapples With Employee Skepticism About New Gemini 4

Passengers Avert Crash by Subduing Pilot Who Stabbed Captain

David Fincher, Director of 'Fight Club,' to Exit Netflix Deal

The shares jumped 37.5% from July through September, their best quarterly showing since 1998, adding $1 trillion to the company's market capitalization. Microsoft also was the fifth-best performer in the technology-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index, which has gained just 0.4% over the last three months.

"After a period where it struggled with the message, Microsoft has been crisper and cleaner on how it will monetize its capital outlay and benefit its customers," said Chad Morganlander, senior portfolio manager at Washington Crossing Advisors and a long-time holder of the stock.

Much of the surge came after Microsoft's earnings in late July, which showed the fastest cloud growth in four years from strong AI demand. The stock jumped 16% the next day, its best session since October 2008, adding $450 billion in market value.

The report eased concerns about whether Microsoft's heavy AI investments would lead to better growth, which is notable because the company has a more encouraging financial profile than the other big spenders like Alphabet Inc., Amazon.com Inc. and Meta Platforms Inc. Of the four, Microsoft is the only one that hasn't seen free cash flow turn negative on an annual basis.

"It is showing a clear path to profitability with AI," Morganlander said. "As a company that is spending but not going into the red on account, it looks like the adult in the room."

Microsoft's rally is particularly impressive considering the speed of the reversal in sentiment. June was the stock's worst month since 2000, as investors questioned the company's spending and the overall outlook for software companies in an AI world. But those industry concerns have eased, and investors were encouraged by the company's effort to transform its Copilot AI assistant into a product for corporate customers.

"There are still fears of a 'SaaSpocalypse,' but it seems like Microsoft is less vulnerable to those issues," Morganlander said. "Meanwhile, people are impressed with how Copilot has been adopted and integrated."

Story Continues

That said, while this quarter's push has carried Microsoft into the green for the year, its 6.1% gain significantly trails the Nasdaq 100's 20% surge.

"It ripped this quarter because people made a mistake," said JoAnne Feeney, portfolio manager at Advisors Capital Management, which owns Microsoft shares. "Investors realized they misunderstood the company's potential, so a lot of the rally is just the reversal of that mistake."

Still, the improving optimism has made Microsoft a darling on Wall Street. There are 72 analysts tracked by Bloomberg who follow the company, and only three don't have buy ratings. No one rates it a sell. And the average price target suggests the shares will rise about 11% in the coming 12 months.

Last week, Stifel upgraded the stock to buy because Microsoft had "clearly turned the corner," according to analyst Brad Reback. The stock's momentum should continue in the second half, he wrote, noting that he's "increasingly comfortable with the company's ability to sustain mid/upper teens revenue growth."

Microsoft shares could generate a total return of roughly 20% over the next year, according Morgan Stanley's Adam Wood, who pointed to its long-term growth potential and the company's recent decision to raise its dividend.

"Combined with high-teens EPS growth, this supports a durable high-teens total return profile at MSFT, framing an attractive risk/reward," Wood wrote in a note dated Sept. 16.

Revenue is expected to rise 18% in Microsoft's 2027 fiscal year, which closes at the end of June, roughly in line with fiscal 2026. Wall Street expects that figure to hit 21% in fiscal 2029. And while earnings per share is expected to climb about 11% in this fiscal year, down from nearly 32% in fiscal 2026, it's projected to reach nearly 19% in fiscal 2028 and 21% in fiscal 2029.

The shares are hardly inexpensive at almost 25 times earnings estimated over the next 12 months, but it's a discount to their 10-year average of 27. Among the market's biggest tech stocks, only Apple Inc. is more expensive.

"Some people want to see more Copilot adoption, or more capabilities in Copilot," Feeney said. "But adoption momentum continues to accelerate, and some of the recent announcements were positive, like we got last week. But it needs to keep delivering."

Tech Chart of the Day

Top Tech Stories

Micron Technology Inc. gave an upbeat forecast for the current quarter, fueled by the AI building frenzy, though the chipmaker warned that rising compensation would weigh on profit margins.

OpenAI accused its Chinese rival Moonshot AI of being responsible for a wide-scale effort to extract data from its GPT artificial intelligence systems that could be used to reproduce the reasoning and capabilities of the company's most advanced models.

Paramount Skydance Corp.'s David Ellison said former Mattel Inc. chief Ynon Kreiz will be co-CEO of the combined companies after completing the pending $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc.

Huawei Technologies Co. plans to join rivals in jacking up smartphone prices to counter rising memory costs, betting on a chips-to-software edge to protect its lead while it explores markets abroad.

Tencent Holdings Ltd. agreed to lease advanced AI chips from Oracle Corp. in Southeast Asia in the Chinese company's biggest such deal yet, the Financial Times reported.

news.Title: The 3 Best Stocks to Buy in October
news.Content:
With October here, it's time to start thinking about which stocks will be great investments in 2027. I've narrowed it down to a handful of stocks, and Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA), Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN), and Nebius (NASDAQ: NBIS) headline them.

These three represent different segments of the market, and each should provide great returns through the end of this year and into next.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Nvidia

Nvidia has been the top AI investment for a long time, and I don't think that's any different heading into 2027. Nvidia's management told investors it expects 70% revenue growth for next year, which is downright impressive considering its size. Furthermore, Nvidia has a very strong track record of outperforming expectations, so the actual growth rate could be far higher.

Nvidia is also entering the end of the year at a fairly low valuation compared to where it normally is. In 2024 and 2025, Nvidia ended the year valued at at least 40 times forward earnings. This year, it's at 24.

NVDA PE Ratio (Forward) data by YCharts

While I don't know if Nvidia will rally to those levels before the year is over, I won't be surprised to see it go higher. That makes it a great candidate to buy now , as none of next year's impressive growth is already priced in.

Amazon

Amazon also looks like a strong stock pick, but it may not be for the reason you think. Amazon may be known for its commerce business, but I think investors should focus on its cloud computing service, Amazon Web Services (AWS). While AWS may not be the focal point for some investors, the reality is that it accounted for 60% of operating income in Q2. It's also growing at a rapid 37% pace, and with the hundreds of billions Amazon is spending on data centers, this growth rate should stay elevated throughout the next few years.

This will lead to outsize profit growth, driving Amazon stock to new heights along the way. With Amazon spending $220 billion on data center capital expenditures this year, investors will start to see some payoff next year with the massive growth it will produce. That makes it a no-brainer stock to buy now, and it could be one of the top-performing stocks next year.

Nebius

Last is Nebius. Nebius is in a similar industry as AWS, as it provides cloud computing services. However, Nebius is completely focused on AI computing, which classifies it as a neocloud computing company. Demand for purpose-built AI computing is massive, and Nebius is acquiring data centers and renting others out as fast as possible.

Story Continues

This is leading to one of the fastest growth rates in the market; it grew at a 454% pace during Q2. That wasn't a flash in the pan either. Wall Street analysts expect monster growth over the next few years, with 520% and 537% growth in Q3 and Q4, and then 270% growth in 2027.

That level of growth is hard to ignore for investors, and it's hard to imagine how much a company growing that quickly can expand. If Nebius can keep that growth rate up into 2028 or 2029, it will be a monstrous business; an investor will want to own a slice of this rapid grower.

These three stocks are great investments for the rest of 2026, because they each have a major catalyst coming with the AI build-out. But I also think they will be strong performers in 2027. That makes them top stocks to buy in October, as you never know when one of these may catch fire.

news.Title: 《韓股》半導體買盤回流 KOSPI收漲1.95%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-01 16:56:49 數位內容中心 發佈

韓股今(1)日明顯走強，韓國KOSPI指數收於6,971.35點，上漲133.31點或1.95%；韓國KOSDAQ指數收於894.29點，上漲38.38點或4.48%。因美國長天期公債殖利率仍處於高檔，韓股早盤表現受到壓抑，不過隨後在半導體買盤回流帶動下，跌勢逐步收斂、翻紅，整體盤勢由偏弱轉為強勢。

news.Title: Alphabet shares up in premarket trade after Gemini 4 Argon launch
news.Content:
Investing.com -- Alphabet Inc Class A (NASDAQ:GOOGL) shares rose about 2% in premarket trading on Thursday after Google launched a new artificial intelligence model, Gemini 4 Argon, touting stronger coding and cybersecurity performance than rival models at lower prices.

Before you buy NVIDIA: our AI model's stock picks are beating the market by 120%+. See the list now »

Google said Gemini 4 Argon will initially be available to a group of trusted cybersecurity researchers before being rolled out more broadly.

The company said paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers will get access first, with wider availability for developers, businesses and consumers to follow.

Jefferies analysts said the model's launch pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens was well below comparable offerings from Anthropic.

Claude Fable 5.1 is priced at $10 and $50, respectively, while Claude Opus 5.5 costs $4 and $20. Google is also offering a 95% discount on cached input tokens.

Google said Gemini 4 Argon scored 77.9% on the DeepSWE v1.1 coding benchmark, a record result. Jefferies noted that it trails leading models on the more demanding FrontierSWE v2 test, but said the model ranked first for coding on LLM Arena's Text Arena. It also ranked eighth on Code Arena: Web Dev, 21 places higher than Gemini 3.8 Flash.

The model's cybersecurity capabilities could be another area of focus for investors. Google said Argon can identify, verify and fix software vulnerabilities autonomously.

Not finding the right stocks? Our AI's list of investor-grade stock picks for October just dropped »

Jefferies said it tied Grok 4.7 for the top score of 68% on CWE-bench v1, which tests vulnerability fixes.

Google also said Argon had a lower success rate for prompt-injection attacks, at 0.7%, compared with 1% for Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1, according to Jefferies.

For its initial cybersecurity rollout, Google said it will provide the model without some of its usual safeguards to trusted defenders and internal teams. Cybersecurity firm Wiz is using Argon through its Scan for Good programme, Google said.

Google said the model also performed strongly on tests covering automation, long-form video and professional work across areas such as finance, legal services and tax. Its output limit has been increased to 1 million tokens from 64,000, compared with 128,000 for Anthropic's rival models, according to Jefferies.

The company said it is already using Argon internally for tasks including software development and data-centre optimisation, although these claims have yet to be independently established as evidence of broader commercial adoption.

Story Continues

Jefferies rates Alphabet "buy" with a $445 price target. The brokerage said the stock had fallen 16% from its May 18 peak as investors worried Alphabet could fall behind rivals while awaiting Gemini 4 Pro.

Jefferies cautioned that real-world use will need to validate the early benchmark results, adding that the systems used to run and evaluate AI models are becoming increasingly important to performance, rather than the models alone.

Google said it plans to strengthen safeguards before wider release, including monitoring the model for signs of misuse and intervening when necessary to prevent harmful actions.

news.Title: 美光直言HBM愈來愈走向客製化，須與台積電CoWoS、英特爾EMIB深化合作
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者李純君報導】美光今日舉行媒體交流茶敘，針對美光的HBM與台積電(2330)CoWoS和英特爾EMIB先進封裝上的技術整合和合作議題，美光提到，HBM不再只是標準化產品，其發展愈來愈偏向客製化設計，美光必須和客戶，以及客戶採用的合作夥伴密切合作。隨著AI晶片朝2奈米製程發展，台積電CoWoS和Intel EMIB等先進封裝技術愈來愈重要，因此就美光如何看待先進封裝對GPU發展及未來AI晶片需求的影響，以及美光與台積電、Intel等公司進行技術整合與合作，有哪些機會等議題，美光釋出看法與說明。

美光強調，先進封裝是HBM的重要一環，市場熟悉Fan-Out或CoWoS等封裝技術，但它們通常屬於2.5D封裝，而HBM則是3D堆疊，更具體的說，HBM是重要且高價值的記憶體，發展方向也愈來愈偏向客製化設計。

因此，美光必須和客戶，以及客戶採用的合作夥伴密切合作，包括剛才提到的CoWoS和EMIB。美光補充，HBM製程結合前段晶圓製造和後段封裝測試，並非單純的封測製程，因此需要晶圓廠技術、專業人才和供應商共同配合，美光必須與主要系統及封裝合作夥伴密切合作，包括CoWoS和EMIB相關夥伴，才能符合客戶緊湊的時程要求。

news.Title: 日本長期利率飆升至30年新高，日股估值仍具吸引力？
news.Content:
商傳媒 ｜吳承岳／台北報導

隨著日本長期利率攀升至近30年來未見的高點，投資人對於日本股市的估值水準產生疑問。截至2026年9月29日，日本10年期公債殖利率已來到3%左右，外界普遍認為利率上升會降低股票的相對吸引力。此時，透過「殖利率價差」（Yield Spread）這項衡量股票與債券相對投資吸引力的傳統指標，來評估日本股市的現況顯得格外重要。

殖利率價差的計算方式，是將債券殖利率減去股票益利率。其中，股票益利率（Equity Yield）是衡量企業獲利能力與股價關係的關鍵指標，其計算方式為每股盈餘（EPS，意指公司每單位股數所賺取的利潤）除以股價，也就是本益比（PER，代表股價是每股盈餘的多少倍）的倒數。例如，若本益比為20倍，股票益利率即為5%。此指標可與債券殖利率進行比較，因為企業保留盈餘有助於未來的成長與股東價值。

儘管日本長期利率大幅上升，但目前的數據顯示日本股市仍具相對投資吸引力。截至2026年9月29日，日本10年期公債殖利率為3.044%，而日經平均指數的預期股票益利率則高達5.899%。換算下來，殖利率價差仍維持在負2.85%。Monex Securities, Inc. 的首席市場分析師吉野 貴晶（Takaaki Yoshino）指出，這代表即使利率處於30年高點，股票的預期收益仍顯著超越債券，從相對角度來看，日本股市的投資吸引力並未減弱。

回顧歷史，在1989年日本泡沫經濟末期，10年期公債殖利率曾高達5.16%，而當時東京證券交易所第一部的平均股票益利率僅1.64%，導致殖利率價差擴大至正3.52%，隨後日經平均指數便開始長期下跌。當殖利率價差接近零或轉為正值時，股市走向通常需要更為謹慎。相較之下，目前美國標準普爾500指數（S&P 500）的殖利率價差已為正0.24%，顯示美國股市在利率與股票收益的關係上，股票的相對吸引力可能有所下降。

不過，殖利率價差作為一種估值指標也有其侷限性，它主要基於當前預期獲利與利率，並未充分考量企業未來的獲利成長潛力。若日本企業獲利能持續增長，日本股票相對於利率的投資吸引力，可能會比殖利率價差所顯示的更高。

半導體與AI族群表現突出，Advantest(6857.JP)、東京威力科創(8035.JP)、軟銀集團(9984.JP)、鎧俠(285A.JP)、Lasertec(6920.JP)與SCREEN Holdings(7735.JP)走強，其中Advantest對日經225指數的拉抬最為明顯。市場資金明顯追捧半導體與電子零組件類股，成為今日大盤上攻的核心動能。相較之下，Tokio Marine Holdings (8766.JP)與Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group(8306.JP)等金融股則承壓。

類股輪動方面，電機、精密機器、資訊與通訊類股表現較佳，非鐵金屬也同步上揚；石油、銀行與保險類股則相對疲弱。Mitsubishi(8058.JP)與Japan Tobacco(2914.JP)等防禦型標的走勢保守，反映市場追價仍集中在成長題材，整體漲勢尚未全面擴散。

news.Title: 製造業PMI衝高、外資連日回補台股！新台幣強勢升值1分收31.842元
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】台北外匯市場週四新台幣兌美元匯價震盪走強，美元指數週三上漲，9月累積漲幅約2%，週四主要亞幣普遍走貶，台幣表現相對強勢，同時，台股走高，加權指數收漲0.86%，外資買超上市股票219.3億元，延續上日買超台股態勢，也給予匯率支撐。新台幣兌美元匯率週四以31.842元作收，與前一交易日比較，台幣匯率升值1分。銀行間新台幣兌美元最高成交價為31.842元，最低成交價為31.946元，成交量為19億4,600萬美元。

標普全球發布9月份台灣製造業採購經理指數，指數從8月份的54.7上升至56.7，連續10個月呈現擴張，並創2021年8月以來最快擴張速度。

標普全球市場財智經濟研究部副總監Annabel Fiddes表示，PMI數據反映台灣受惠於本土和主要出口巿場的需求升溫，客戶遍及歐洲、中國大陸、美國、日本等地。惟調查結果亦指出，企業面對產能和供應端的壓力持續加劇，供應商因缺料造成延宕時間拉長，入列2022年年初以來最高。

news.Title: 名師操盤》台股站回4萬8！資金轉向低位階股 9檔強棒成新寵
news.Content:
周四台股指數持續高檔震盪，終場上漲413點，以48,353點作收，K線收紅，再度站上4萬8千點關卡，後續持續觀察指數能否站穩3至5天以上。

成交量為8,374億元，較前一日的8,756億元略為縮減，呈現「價漲量縮」格局，顯示盤面輪動速度較快，部分買盤轉趨觀望。

從日K線來看，周四多方表態，指數一舉站上今年6月下旬高點48,218點之上。後續若能在此位置站穩5至8天，48,218點將有機會由原先的壓力轉為支撐，將有助於多方進一步向上挑戰5萬點，甚至更高的目標。

至於OTC指數，周三出現日級別「日出」訊號後，周四延續上攻走勢。目前OTC指數為418.82點，今年6月高點則為459.56點，距離前波高點仍有一段空間，因此多方仍須持續表態，中小型股的攻勢才能延續。

從台股日KD指標來看，周四日K值終於進入80以上的強勢區，後續觀察日D值能否同步跟進。若KD兩值能雙雙站上80，將有利於盤面賺錢效應進一步發酵。

以周四收盤數據來看，上市櫃市場個股表現仍呈現漲跌互見。上市股票上漲405家、下跌558家；上櫃股票上漲307家、下跌415家，上市櫃合計下跌家數仍高於上漲家數。

不過，周四上市共有23檔漲停，上櫃則有27檔漲停，合計50檔個股漲停，持續高於40檔的基本觀察門檻，顯示市場買盤仍維持一定進場意願，部分個股也具有明顯追價力道。

盤面上，先前維繫市場人氣的玻璃基板族群漲多後進入整理，資金開始轉往其他低位階族群點火，包括被動元件、功率元件及石英元件等，周四盤中皆可看到買盤進駐。

這些族群有一個共同特徵，就是今年7月受到全球去槓桿影響，股價曾經歷一波修正；到了8、9月，雖然大盤強勁反彈，這些個股卻沒有同步上漲，反而持續反覆打底、清洗浮額。如今經過近2個月整理，部分個股逐漸出現底部成形的跡象，只要後續買盤持續進駐，行情就有機會重新啟動。

這也可能成為10月，甚至今年第4季盤面的重要機會所在。

其中，隨著資料中心電力規格升級，朝高功率、高電壓方向發展，AI伺服器對高階被動元件及功率元件的需求持續升溫。被動元件族群如國巨、華新科、光頡、禾伸堂、蜜望實、立隆電；功率元件則包括德微、強茂、富鼎等，周四股價全面轉強，後續可持續觀察其續航力道。

此外，負責穩定時脈的高精度石英元件，同樣值得留意。由於相關元件可協助AI資料中心進行通訊傳輸時維持時序穩定，市場需求也有望受惠，包括晶技、希華、加高等個股，周四股價同步轉強，後續可持續追蹤。

另一方面，半導體供應鏈的資金輪動也持續進行。先進封裝設備的均華、大量，ASIC概念的智原、億而得、晶心科，晶圓代工的聯電、世界，以及MCU族群的新唐、雅特力等，近日也相繼加入輪動行列，皆可列入後續觀察名單。

整體來看，目前多方可用之兵逐漸增加，後續盤面可能採取「輪番整理、輪流上攻」的方式推進。若資金輪動能夠延續，將有助於第4季多頭攻勢維持熱度，後續行情仍值得持續關注。

受到美國聯準會(Fed) 10月升息機率降低帶動，台股今(1)日早盤開高，盤中雖一度陷入震盪，但臨近尾盤在台積電、聯發科等電子權值股走揚，加上被動元件族群強漲助攻下，激勵加權指數漲勢擴大，終場收在最高點48353.49點，上漲413.36點或0.86%，順利站回48000點大關並創下歷史收盤新高，成交量略縮為8374.31億元。

儘管美國最新經濟數據顯示8月通膨壓力趨緩、降低Fed 10月升息預期，標準普爾500指數仍在9月最後一個交易日收低，但那斯達克指數微幅收高。亞洲股市方面，因美國科技股昨日走揚，日本半導體相關股聞訊嗨漲，帶動日經225指數開高走高，終場大漲3.30%；韓國KOSPI指數收漲1.95%。

台股今日資金明顯回流電子族群，帶動大盤穩步墊高。電子股普遍上漲，權王台積電開高走高，終場收在2510元，上漲1.21%，聯發科亦收漲1.22%，聯電、欣興、奇鋐、健策、日月光投控連袂走揚。另外，被動元件族群受惠需求持續升溫，國巨*、華容、千如、鈞寶、今展科、泰藝、勤凱等多檔齊步上攻漲停，立敦、禾伸堂、蜜望實、立隆電、金山電也紛紛走高。

觀察29大類股表現，今日以通信網路類股漲勢最強、漲幅達2.71%，電子通路、電子零組件類股分別上漲2.19%、1.90%，三大強勢類股集中在電子相關領域，顯示今日盤勢主軸仍由科技股帶動。反觀油電燃氣類股則跌勢較重，其餘包括玻璃陶瓷、水泥、生技醫療等族群亦同步收黑。

三大法人動向方面，今日三大法人合計買超292.52億元；其中，自營商買超16.59億元，投信買超56.57億元，外資及陸資買超219.37億元。

Shares of Broadcom's have gained +2.9% over the year-to-date period against the Zacks Electronics - Semiconductors industry's gain of +35.3%. news.Title: Zacks Earnings Trends Highlights: Micron, Nvidia and Alphabet
news.Content:
For Immediate Release

Chicago, IL – October 1, 2026 – Zacks Director of Research Sheraz Mian says, "Total S&P 500 earnings in Q3 are currently expected to increase +24.1% from the same period last year on +11.6% higher revenues."

Q3 Earnings on Track for 8th Straight Quarter of Double-Digit Growth

Note: The following is an excerpt from this week's Earnings Trends report. You can access the full report that contains detailed historical actual and estimates for the current and following periods, please click here>>>

Here are the key points:

Total S&P 500 earnings in Q3 are currently expected to increase +24.1% from the same period last year on +11.6% higher revenues, with 14 of the 16 Zacks sectors expected to enjoy positive earnings growth and 6 sectors producing double-digit growth. This will be the most broad-based earnings growth performance in recent times.

With Conglomerates (-35.2%) and Consumer Staples (-0.1%) as the only Zacks sectors expected to have lower Q3 earnings relative to the year-earlier period, the quarter is on track to produce an impressively broad-based growth performance. Q3 will also be the 8th straight quarter of double-digit earnings growth for the S&P 500 index.

Sectors expected to enjoy double-digit earnings growth in Q3 are Aerospace (+159.7%), Energy (+111.8%), Tech (+42.1%), Basic Materials (+29.7%), Transportation (+14.4%), and Industrial Products (+13.1%).

Micron MU and Nvidia NVDA continue to be material contributors to the Tech sector's growth picture. Excluding Nvidia, Micron, and Alphabet GOOGL, which enjoyed an outsized gain in the preceding period, Q3 earnings for the rest of the Tech sector would be +20.6% (vs. +42.1% otherwise).

The Earnings Big Picture

Since the start of Q3, the Energy sector has enjoyed the most pronounced upgrade to its earnings outlook, reflecting elevated oil prices as a result of the Persian Gulf situation. Other sectors enjoying positive estimate revisions since the start of Q3 include Aerospace, Industrial Products, Tech, Autos, Transportation, Finance, and Utilities. It is significant to note that the aggregate revisions trend would still be positive if we excluded the positive revisions to the Energy or Tech sector.

The Tech sector remains a major contributor to aggregate earnings growth, with Q3 earnings growth dropping to +14.5% once the sector's contribution is excluded from the index. The semiconductor industry within the Tech sector has enjoyed a particularly robust demand environment lately, and that trend remains in place in Q3 as well.

Story Continues

The Zacks Semiconductor industry at the mezzanine level is expected to enjoy +85.5% earnings growth in 2026 Q3 on +62.8% revenue growth, following the industry's +110.1% and +96% earnings growth in each of the preceding two periods.

The Tech sector's +42.1% earnings growth in Q3 drops to +29.6% once the semiconductor's contribution is excluded. If we exclude Nvidia, Micron, and Alphabet, Q3 earnings growth for the rest of the Zacks Tech sector drops to +20.6%.

The favorable revisions trend noted earlier in the context of Q3 estimates is also at play with estimates for the last quarter of the year, with mostly the same sectors enjoying positive revisions.

news.Title: 台股收48353點寫新高　被動元件與ABF載板族群走強
news.Content:
（中央社記者何秀玲台北1日電）台股今天開高震盪，盤中一度翻黑，不過台積電等電子權值股走揚，加上被動元件及ABF載板族群表現強勁，帶動大盤回升，加權指數終場上漲413.36點，收48353.49點，創收盤新高，漲幅0.86%，成交值新台幣8374.31億元。

電子權值股方面，台積電上漲30元，收2510元，漲幅1.21%；鴻海上漲2.5元，收254元，漲幅0.99%；聯發科上漲60元，收4980元，漲幅1.22%；台達電上漲15元，收1905元，漲幅0.79%。

被動元件族群表現強勁，華容、國巨及華新科分別收58.4元、602元及329元，均攻上漲停；禾伸堂、蜜望實分別上漲7.71%、6.13%；立隆電、金山電分別上漲5.85%、5.83%。

ABF載板族群走強，欣興上漲3.4%，收1215元；景碩上漲4.12%，收1010元，首度站上千元大關；南電上漲5.97%，收1420元。

資深證券分析師簡伯儀表示，目前台股量能不足，後續須觀察成交量能否放大，以及指數能否守住5日均線；若支撐未跌破，且有量能配合，指數有機會再創新高。（編輯：林家嫻）1151001

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》物流自動化—GXO、CGNX、AMZN
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-01 14:20:39 數位內容中心 發佈

GXO Logistics（GXO.US）

9月17日，GXO Logistics宣布在荷蘭芬洛為Guess部署Exotec Skypod系統，配置127台機器人與60,000個貨架儲位，日處理量可達40,000至70,000件。這顯示貨到人揀貨與機器人調度已在大型服飾物流中心進入實際落地。

Exotec

隨Guess荷蘭專案揭露，Exotec本週更新Skypod部署進度，系統已用於超過75個品牌客戶，並部署於全球200多個站點。這次訊號不在單一新案，而在其倉儲機器人平台已從單點導入轉向跨站點複製。

Agility Robotics

9月15日發布的新一代Digit 5，本週同步揭露截至今年5月已取得超過3億美元多年期訂單，並在9個客戶設施取得部署承諾。公司累積超過6.5萬小時運行紀錄，顯示人形機器人正由展示走向倉儲搬運實測。

Cognex（CGNX.US）

9月22日，Cognex簽署最終協議，以5億美元全現金收購RealSense，交易預計於2026年第4季完成。RealSense最新D585可在裝置端以每秒最高30次直接計算深度，顯示其機器視覺正由2D辨識延伸至3D感知。

Amazon.com（AMZN.US）

9月24日，Amazon宣布將在印第安納州Greenwood興建先進製造設施，投資超過1億美元，作為支援北美物流網路設備與機器人的專用生產基地。該廠預計2028年營運，並將成為其第4座專用機器人製造據點。

FedEx（FDX.US）

FedEx領軍財團本週持續推進對InPost的收購，交易估值約90億美元；InPost目前在歐洲9個國家營運約70,000個自動化包裹櫃。這反映物流自動化投資已由倉內設備延伸至末端交付網路節點。

Dexterity

Dexterity近期完成9,500萬美元新一輪募資，估值升至16.5億美元，並表示旗艦卡車裝載機器人DexR已導入實際物流場景。公司同時強調其系統已在FedEx、UPS、GXO等大型物流業者場域使用。

news.Title: 外資續減碼日股、大賣短債；日人續買海外股票
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-01 13:23:12 蔡承啟 發佈

外資連3週減碼日股，大賣日本短期債、週賣超額創今年來次高，而日本投資人(日人)連3週加碼海外股票。

日本財務省1日公佈統計數據指出，上週(9月20-26日)外資在日本股市賣超3,620億日圓，為連續第3週減碼日股；2026年迄今(截至9月26日為止)外資買超日股的累計金額縮小至2兆9,045億日圓。外資上上週(9月13-19日)賣超日股金額達4兆9,425億日圓，週賣超額創2005年1月開始進行統計以來歷史新高紀錄。

上週外資賣超日本中長期債券金額為1兆3,418億日圓，連續第2週站在賣方，週賣超額創9週來(7月19-25日當週以來、賣超1兆5,141億日圓)新高、今年來第3高水準；賣超日本短期債券金額達3兆2,672億日圓，4週來第3度站在賣方，週賣超額創今年來次高水準(僅低於3月22-28日當週的賣超4兆1,578億日圓)。

總計外資上週流出日本金融市場的資金總額為4兆9,711億日圓，連續第3週呈現淨流出。

上週日本投資人(日人)在海外股市買超2,258億日圓，連續第3週加碼海外股票；2026年迄今(截至9月26日為止)日人買超海外股票的累計金額擴大至1兆6,527億日圓。

日人上週賣超海外中長期債券金額為6,845億日圓，連續第2週站在賣方；買超海外短期債券金額為1,309億日圓，連續第4週站在買方。

news.Title: 小摩看好後市！日股科技ETF強勢強彈 代理式AI引爆半導體新機會
news.Content:
第三季全球市場雖歷經通膨與地緣政治震盪，但進入9月後，隨著市場消化利空且AI需求強勁，投資情緒迅速回溫。摩根大通指出科技股經修正後評價面與籌碼均已沉澱，重申看好後市。受此激勵，台股掛牌的日本半導體ETF近一個月強彈，在雲端巨頭擴增資本支出與代理式AI應用的帶動下，日本半導體設備與上游供應鏈正迎來新一輪成長契機。

在法人看好與基本面修復帶動下，台灣掛牌的日股相關ETF表現極為亮眼。截至9月30日近一個月統計，聚焦半導體產業的中信日本半導體(00954-TW)與台新日本半導體(00951-TW)雙雙大漲逾 7%，領跑市場；中信日本商社(00955-TW)亦上漲 3.4%。此外，大盤型標的如野村日本東證(009812-TW)及國泰日經225(00657-TW)也有逾 2% 的漲幅，顯示市場資金已顯著回流日本科技與大型權值股。

展望後市，小摩認為全球AI基礎建設仍處於強勁擴張期。隨著各大雲端服務供應商(CSP)2027年資本支出上看 1.4 兆美元，半導體設備出貨規模持續向上。其中，日本在半導體設備領域具有高度壟斷與技術優勢，如東京威力科創、愛德萬測試等指標性大廠，將長期受惠於這波AI浪潮。

同時，半導體上游供應鏈(包含設備、關鍵化學材料及零組件)與終端客戶的合作深度顯著提升。近期產業鏈頻頻透過私募、共同開發與策略結盟等方式強化綁定，不僅讓供應商能提早掌握客戶需求、拉長訂單能見度，也驅動市場持續上修企業獲利預期，基本面展現強勁支撐。

針對產業前瞻趨勢，中信日本半導體ETF經理人許家瑜表示，代理式AI(Agentic AI)已成為下一階段的關鍵驅動力，產業發展正從單純的「內容生成」轉向「任務執行與流程自動化」。隨著 Meta 推出 Muse、OpenAI 等巨頭加速拓展相關應用，具備全天候自主運作特性的 AI 代理將帶動算力與半導體需求持續擴大。

雲端大廠的資本支出數據也佐證了這項趨勢。以 AI 新銳 Anthropic 為例，其招股文件揭露未來數年將投入高達 5,180 億美元 於雲端運算與基礎建設，對比去年約 73 億美元呈現爆發式成長，突顯全球對算力的迫切需求。

綜合來看，在 AI 應用滲透率提升、CSP 大廠資本支出維持高檔，以及半導體迎來新一輪成長週期下，市場持續看好半導體上游供應鏈、關鍵設備、化學材料及 AI 基礎建設相關受惠題材的長期表現。

news.Title: 資金輪動，台股Q4首日重回4萬8，被動元件、ABF載板接棒走強
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃冠豪】台股今日迎接第四季首個交易日，美股前一晚科技股相對有撐，加上亞洲半導體股氣氛回溫，台股早盤開高，加權指數以47,961.98點開出後，一度衝上48,181.49點，上漲超過240點，不過隨著金融股走弱及高檔獲利了結賣壓出現，漲幅快速收斂。櫃買指數盤中上漲約0.2%，中小型電子股表現也呈現震盪。亞洲股市方面，韓國KOSPI指數午盤前維持紅盤，來到約6,900點附近、上漲約0.9%。不過韓國兩大記憶體指標股走勢分歧，三星電子盤中約268,000韓元、下跌0.19%；SK海力士則約178.8萬韓元、上漲0.68%，顯示AI記憶體族群仍有承接，但追價力道並不一致。

日本股市則明顯偏多，日經225指數開盤即上漲352.8點登67,106.52點，午後漲幅一度擴大至逾1,800點或2.8%。美國科技股相對抗跌，加上市場對升息預期稍微降溫，帶動日本AI、半導體設備股成為主要撐盤力量。

台權值股表現分歧，台積電(2330)早盤最高來到2,505元附近，上漲25元，持續扮演穩盤角色；聯發科(2454)由黑翻紅，盤中約4,930元，上漲10元；聯電(2303)表現相對強勢，盤中來到159元，上漲4.5元或2.91%。

熱門族群方面，今天最突出的資金焦點首先落在被動元件。電容族群盤中漲幅一度達4.44%，國巨(2327)、華新科(2492)強攻漲停，日電貿(3090)、立隆電(2472)、凱美(2375)、禾伸堂(3026)同步走高，成為10月第一個交易日最整齊的多方類股之一。

PCB供應鏈則維持輪動，其中ABF載板明顯接棒昨日面板、玻璃基板行情，南電(8046)早盤一度大漲逾7%，欣興(3037)、景碩(3189)、臻鼎-KY(4958)同步維持紅盤，反映AI GPU、ASIC及高速交換器帶來的大尺寸、高層數載板需求仍是市場核心題材。

PCB、CCL則以高階AI伺服器材料為資金觀察重點，市場持續聚焦金像電(2368)、華通(2313)以及台光電(2383)、台燿(6274)、聯茂(6213)等高階CCL供應商，但族群走勢較偏個股輪動，強度不如被動元件與ABF全面。

至於前波熱門的矽光子、光通訊，今天盤中震盪明顯加大，聯亞(3081)、光聖(6442)、華星光(4979)、上詮(3363)等高價股仍是成交焦點，但經過前段急漲後，資金開始在光通訊與PCB、載板、被動元件之間快速切換。

整體來看，第四季頭一天台股不是單純的指數行情，而是明顯呈現「權值股穩盤、低基期電子接棒」格局。48,000點仍是短線多空重要關卡；若台積電能維持2,500元附近、加上被動元件與ABF載板熱度延續，台股仍有機會維持高檔震盪偏多，但前波漲幅較大的光通訊、CCL及高價PCB股，短線波動也將同步放大。

news.Title: 台股ETF新寵是「這檔」？成交金額超車0050、受益人數狂飆355%　主動式ETF績效如何？
news.Content:
屬主動式ETF的00981A，近來表現引發市場討論。示意圖，與新聞個案無關。（資料照，顏麟宇攝）

台股9月最後一個交易日（9月30日）盤中一度大漲超過700點，午後獲利了結賣壓出籠，終場加權指數收在47940.13點，上漲308.17點；而近期市場討論度相當高的00981A（主動統一台股增長），則以30.54元作收，當日上漲0.23元、0.76%，成交量約9.9萬張。對此，股人阿勳今（1）日在臉書粉專指出，上周00981A單日成交金額已超過0050（元大台灣50），成為ETF第一名。本文整理 00981A持股 、 近來股價表現， 以及 主動式ETF和傳統被動式ETF的差別 。

主動式ETF是什麼？00981A有多少人持有？

統一投信旗下的主動式ETF​00981A於2025年成立，與傳統被動式ETF不同，是由基金經理人主動選股，從台股市值前300大企業中挑選標的，且至少60%配置大型股，00981A近期引發市場討論的原因之一，是受益人數快速增加，根據證交所截至9月24日的集保資料，00981A受益人數達945,851人，年初至今增加738,100人、增幅355.28%，在台股ETF受益人數排行第5名，已逼近百萬人。

00981A近期股價怎麼走？有哪些成分股？

從近期表現來看，00981A並不是一路上漲，而是隨台股震盪。證交所ETF資料顯示，截至9月10日，00981A近1個月上漲4.77%、3個月上漲2.04%、6個月大漲63.84%、1年上漲125.09%；9月30日則以30.54元作收。 00981A於9月30日最新前十大持股資料 如下：

台積電（9.97%）

聯發科（8.77%）

欣興（8.28%）

台光電（8.04%）

奇鋐（7.09%）

股人阿勳特別點出，9月23日ETF成交金額第一名不是0050，而是00981A，單日成交金額68.82億元，且不只是散戶在追；當日，三大法人合計買超13.83萬張，其中外資就買超9.03萬張，且已連續買超多日。績效方面，他盤點，00981A自今年以來上漲約81%，近一年漲幅超過120%。至於既然主動式ETF績效強，為何還要買0050？他分析，不能只單看報酬率，相比之下0050相對單純，跟著台灣大型權值股長期成長，不必猜經理人下一步要買什麼。

news.Title: 台股最狂妖股！從傳產變AI紅人「三季猛漲578％」 突跌停散戶傻眼
news.Content:
台股今年漲幅驚人的「妖股」上演驚心動魄行情！上櫃不鏽鋼管配件大廠大甲今（1）日盤中股價一度衝上193元、改寫歷史新高，沒想到高檔獲利了結賣壓隨即湧現，股價快速翻黑下殺，盤中一度觸及跌停價178元，終止連續9個交易日上漲的強勢紀錄。

大甲今年股價走勢堪稱瘋狂，以2025年12月31日收盤價30元計算，今年前三季累計漲幅高達578.69%，在上櫃市場名列前茅。9月中旬以前，大甲股價仍在百元以下震盪整理，9月15日買盤突然大量湧入，自此以後展開一波強勁上攻行情。

大甲此後股價一路創高，9月30日更攻上198元，再寫歷史新高，並拉出驚人的連9漲。然而，短線漲幅快速擴大後，今日盤中多方獲利了結賣壓明顯增加，股價開盤跳空至190.5元後一路走低，最低一度打到178元跌停價，高檔劇烈震盪。

大甲這波股價之受到市場追捧，背後與全球半導體資本支出擴張，以及AI資料中心對高階液冷散熱管路需求升溫有關，大甲原本以傳統不鏽鋼管配件為主，近年積極切入高階應用市場，轉型題材受到投資人高度關注。

不過，大甲股價快速上漲的同時，籌碼與估值風險也受到市場關注，9月30日遭櫃買中心列入注意股，近期多項漲幅及交易指標均達注意標準，後續走勢也成為市場持續關注的焦點。

news.Title: AI資本支出旺到2027年！法巴銀財富管理調升「加碼」全球股市 看好台韓日股
news.Content:
看好人工智慧（AI）相關投資建置熱潮可望延續至2027年，法國巴黎銀行財富管理指出，儘管高利率環境與持續的地緣政治風險仍對全球金融市場構成壓力，但整體股市展現出強勁韌性。隨著市場漲勢逐步由AI基礎設施相關受惠股，擴大至其他產業類股，在強健的經濟基本面與企業獲利成長支撐下，已正式將全球股票配置比重由中性調升至「加碼」；其中亞洲尤其受惠於全球AI供應鏈，特別點名台股、韓股、日股及中國A股。

法國巴黎銀行財富管理香港首席投資策略師譚慧敏分析，每年9月與10月通常是金融市場波動較劇烈的月份，短期內不排除出現較明顯的回檔修正，但從中長期趨勢來看，市場回檔反而提供極佳的加碼股票時機。目前AI資本支出依舊是支撐美國經濟運行的重要核心動能，特別是作為AI發展關鍵基礎設施的資料中心，相關投資建置熱潮可望延續至2027年。

在區域市場配置方面，法國巴黎銀行財富管理將新興市場投資觀點由「中性」上調至「加碼」，並同步把台灣股市與南韓股市的投資評等由「中性」調升至「加碼」。法國巴黎銀行財富管理強調，亞洲在全球AI供應鏈與基礎建設主題中佔據關鍵核心地位，是目前最具信心的配置方向，且台灣與南韓股市目前的風險報酬條件相當有利。此外，日本股市與中國A股同樣名列當前看好的市場名單中。

針對產業類股挑選，法國巴黎銀行財富管理持續看好全球醫療保健、工業及礦業，以及歐洲地區的公用事業與銀行業。其中，工業類股主要受惠於製造業回流、再工業化趨勢、國防需求、AI應用及大規模基礎建設投資；醫療保健類股則擁有新藥研發突破、AI整合應用與併購活動增加等多重利多，且目前整體評價面仍處於相對偏低位置，具備極佳吸引力。

在債券市場布局上，法國巴黎銀行財富管理香港首席投資策略師譚慧敏認為，短期內美國公債殖利率仍有繼續走揚的可能，但預期明年將逐步轉向回落，因此目前在債券配置上偏好短天期債券。法國巴黎銀行財富管理維持美國10年期公債殖利率未來12個月4.5%的目標價位，同時不排除未來數月間殖利率可能短暫突破5%關卡。

另一方面，法國巴黎銀行財富管理已將核心歐元區政府債券投資觀點由「中性」上調至「加碼」，並特別偏好7年至10年期債券，主因近期殖利率上升後，長期預期報酬率的投資價值已再度顯現。

news.Title: 白宮六家AI業者簽自律協議，輝達、Meta力阻集中監管方案
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】英國《金融時報》與《華爾街日報》報導，美國總統川普與AI企業高層會面後，Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Meta、xAI及輝達六家公司簽署自願性安全協議，承諾強化內部控制、接受外部審計，並建立董事會監督機制。協議未要求放慢模型開發，也未建立具約束力的統一監管標準，顯示白宮目前傾向透過企業自律處理風險，維持AI產業擴張。協議要求企業持續監測先進模型帶來的網路與生物安全威脅，防止模型以非預期方式入侵其他系統，並由獨立外部機構核驗控制措施，再由董事會層級的獨立委員會監督。部分主要AI實驗室此前已進行模型能力評估，因此新增要求的實際影響，取決於各家公司既有制度與落實程度。川普將協議稱為「道德約束」，但法律人士指出，企業若公開承諾卻未履行，仍可能引發消費者保護與不實陳述方面的執法問題。

產業內部對監督架構仍有明顯分歧。《華爾街日報》引述知情人士表示，輝達執行長黃仁勳(Jensen Huang)等高層在小範圍會議中，當面詢問Anthropic執行長阿莫迪(Dario Amodei)，為何公開發出如此強烈的AI風險警告；阿莫迪則強調，應誠實說明模型能力與風險。

報導提到，Meta執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)、黃仁勳及馬斯克(Elon Musk)先前反對仿照美國金融業監管局(FINRA)成立AI自律組織，擔憂權力過度集中於少數企業，最終促成較寬鬆的自願協議。

對科技供應鏈而言，市場關注安全要求是否帶來額外的模型測試、推理運算及持續監控需求。InvestorPlace分析師蘭戈(Luke Lango)認為，相關支出可能增加資料傳輸與協調需求，使輝達(美股代碼NVDA)、邁威爾科技(美股代碼MRVL)、安謀(美股代碼ARM)及光通訊業者Lumentum(美股代碼LITE)受到關注。不過，這屬產業需求推估，協議本身並未公布採購金額或算力預算；企業自律能否兼顧安全與開發速度，以及FTC調查的後續結果，仍將影響政策不確定性與資本支出方向。

news.Title: 《日股早盤》半導體嗨、日經噴1,602點 MLCC飆
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-01 10:40:26 蔡承啟 發佈

news.Title: 【台股盤中】台股狹幅震盪　被動元件族群走強
news.Content:
（中央社記者何秀玲台北2026年10月1日電）台股今天開高，盤中最高達48181.49點，上漲逾240點，隨後漲幅收斂，在平盤附近狹幅震盪。權王台積電 (2330) 上漲20元至2500元，被動元件族群表現較強，矽晶圓族群部分走揚。

9時51分左右，加權指數為47995.39點，上漲55.26點，漲幅0.12%，成交值約新台幣3383億元，電子類股指數上漲0.47%，金融類股指數下跌2.04%。代表中小型股票的櫃買指數上漲0.37%。

被動元件族群盤中走強，國巨 (2327) 上漲逾7%；華新科 (2492) 、華容 (5328) 、蜜望實 (8043) 上漲逾5%，金山電 (8042) 、日電貿 (3090) 漲逾3%。

群益投信主動式台股ETF研究團隊表示，台灣外銷訂單已連續19個月正成長，主要由資通信及電子產品年增超過70%所推升，顯示全球科技巨頭龐大的Capex持續反映在台灣AI硬體供應鏈的訂單上，也對以電子出口為經濟根基的台灣添助更為紮實的基本面底氣，根據近五次台灣外銷訂單正成長維持10個月以上之經驗，大盤於期間表現亮眼，平均漲幅近42.71%。後續來看，在AI需求強勁下，亦有望進一步推升台廠業績表現。再者，第四季向來又是消費電子旺季，外銷訂單有望延續成長趨勢，對於台股行情正向看待。不過在股市處於高檔之際，類股輪動亦頻繁，靈活選股才更有助於掌握趨勢行情，建議投資人可透過主動式市值ETF來掌握行情。

主動群益核心50 (00415A)經理人許育誌表示，隨著全球科技巨頭積極投入AI基礎建設與算力布局，反映AI長線需求未見降溫。台灣在半導體、伺服器、IC 設計及關鍵零組件供應鏈中佔據核心地位，為此波AI浪潮下的最大受惠國，不僅反映在外銷訂單的增長，也進一步傳導至上市櫃公司獲利與股價表現，連帶市值排名更替也較以往頻繁，數檔得益於AI趨勢的(準)千金股崛起，因此能因應市況彈性調整持股的主動式台股市值型ETF更是投資人可多加運用的工具，以更即時掌握AI多元商機。次產業方面，包括先進製程、封裝、載板、散熱、電源模組等值得留意。

news.Title: 台積2奈米良率甩三星/Intel？先進製程滿到2028
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-01 09:14:27 郭妍希 發佈

一名台灣半導體研究專家透露，台積電先進製程晶圓產能直到2028年上半年都已售罄。此外，台積電用於汽車及工業應用的成熟製程產能也面臨限制。

Investing.com、The Motley Fool 30日報導，上述專家在Piper Sandler舉行的網路研討會上表示，記憶體供應仍是系統層面最大的風險。沒有記憶體，就無法提供算力。高頻寬記憶體(HBM)、DRAM及快閃記憶體(Flash)的短缺，已迫使下一代系統在設計上做出取捨。

該名專家表示，資本支出愈來愈受到供應鏈交付能力限制，而非需求不足。設備供應商難以按照需求出貨，其中微影設備供應商在跟上極紫外光(EUV)設備建置與升級速度方面，面臨的挑戰尤其嚴峻。

這名專家並表示，以2奈米同等製程來看，台積電在良率方面領先三星電子(Samsung Electronics Co.) 6個季度，領先英特爾(Intel Corp.) 11個季度。台積電2奈米及3奈米製程仍是獲利能力最高的製程，目前正持續擴大產能，2027年2奈米月產量目標為20萬片晶圓。A16製程則已進入風險試產。

包括GPU及ASIC在內的XPU，2026年出貨量預計將達1,400萬顆。該名專家預估，2027年出貨量將再成長50%，2028年再增加40%。其中約66%的成長來自ASIC放量，約33%來自GPU。

在ASIC方面，2027年的成長大概主要由Google TPU帶動，而微軟(Microsoft)、Meta及OpenAI的ASIC晶片，預計2027年各自都將達到接近100萬顆的規模。GPU方面，輝達(Nvidia)則同時布局多種機櫃及架構版本，以分散風險。

news.Title: 台股開盤上漲逾200點 台積電撐盤漲15元 友達續噴逾1％
news.Content:
美國公布8月個人消費支出（PCE）物價指數，顯示通膨沒有想像中嚴重，投資人開始預期聯準會（Fed）10月可能不會升息，不過，美股漲多面臨賣壓，道瓊工業指數收盤下挫逾400點，台股今（1）日開盤上漲逾200點，約來到48181.49點。

台積電漲15元至2495元，市場資金再度向面板族群集中，韓媒報導輝達正評估在下一代AI晶片封裝中導入玻璃基板技術，由於輝達執行長黃仁勳過去也曾與SK集團會長崔泰源討論下一代玻璃基板技術，帶動面板股繼昨日強漲後，今（1）日續強，友達續噴逾1%。被動元件股也成為盤面強勢焦點，國巨漲近5%。

台股昨（30）日開高震盪，盤中一度上漲逾700點，但尾盤受台積電爆出約1.4萬張賣單影響，終場僅上漲308點，收47940點站回5日線，成交量8756億。三大法人都站在買方，外資買超296.36億，投信買超77.81億，自營商買超12.4億，合計買超386.57億。

美股道瓊下跌443.87點或0.86%，收50,906.05點。S&P500下跌19.30點或0.25%，收7,651.54點。NASDAQ上漲63.52點或0.24%，收26,861.06點。費城半導體下跌0.54點或0.00%，收12,628.62點。

news.Title: Alphabet stock slips on report of internal doubts over Gemini 4
news.Content:
Investing.com -- Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) shares declined Wednesday heading to the market close, paring gains to up 0.5% from up over 2%, following a Bloomberg report that highlighted internal employee skepticism about the performance of the company's upcoming Gemini 4 artificial intelligence model.

Before you buy NVIDIA: our AI model's stock picks are beating the market by 120%+. See the list now »

The report indicated that while Gemini 4 has performed well on industry benchmarks used to gauge model efficacy, it performs less effectively when employees put it to work on actual tasks. The model struggles to handle certain coding tasks, according to people with direct access to the effort cited by Bloomberg.

Google disputed the characterization, stating it would be inaccurate to say that Gemini 4 is underperforming in areas such as coding. The company pointed to comments made last week by Koray Kavukcuoglu, head of Google DeepMind, who said he was encouraged by the model's performance.

Not finding the right stocks? Our AI's list of investor-grade stock picks for October just dropped »

The report also revealed that Google had planned to release a different version in June, dubbed Gemini 3.5 Pro, but abandoned the effort. According to the Bloomberg report, some employees believe Anthropic's Fable and OpenAI's Astra models are improving at a faster rate than Gemini, while other employees believe Gemini 4 has caught up with leading AI labs.

A Google employee familiar with model development told Bloomberg there is "large consensus" internally that Gemini 4 is at the frontier and denied that the models struggle with real-world coding tasks.

Versions of the Gemini model underpin nearly every product Google sells, from AI answers in Search to Maps, Gmail and Chrome. Each of those products has more than a billion users.

news.Title: 大華銀投信：00918定期定額卡位 台股Q4行情
news.Content:
【記者柯安聰台北報導】大華優利高填息30（00918）經理人郭修誠表示，AI產業正加速從生成式AI（訓練端）轉向代理AI與邊緣AI（推論端），預估2026年全球AI市場規模將衝上3120億美元，至2030年更將達8270億美元，年複合成長率高達27.7%。台灣作為全球科技硬體製造大國，從電力能源、半導體、AI伺服器組裝到高速傳輸等基礎建設，皆全面供貨吃緊AI升級紅利。郭修誠對台股第4季傳統旺季基本面仍抱持高度正面看法。

郭修誠進一步分析，新一代AI運算架構的投入帶動高速傳輸與板材升級需求暴增，AI伺服器主機板層數已增至28~46層，帶動高階銅箔基板（CCL）與高層數PCB需求呈現價量俱揚爆發。大華優利高填息30持股緊密對齊此波AI升級潮流，重倉配置廣達、緯穎、華碩、緯創等伺服器組裝與雲端運算龍頭，同時納入半導體IC設計廠瑞昱，直接受惠於AI晶片推論需求爆發與硬體規格跳升趨勢。

郭修誠指出，除了AI算力的硬體爆發力外，盤面資金在長假前的避險需求亦轉向具備評價優勢的金融族群。券商研報特別點名，富邦金、國泰金、玉山金與元大金等金控巨頭獲利穩健，00918亦配置了中信金、兆豐金、玉山金、第一金與台新新光金等優質金控，透過優質金融股的低估值與穩定現金流，為整體資產組合打造堅實的防禦屏障。

大華銀投信表示，00918憑藉「高股利率＋高填息率」獨家雙因子篩選機制，兼具「AI算力爆發」與「金融防禦打底」雙引擎，建議投資人不妨視己身風險承受度，善用「定期定額＋股息再投資（DRIP）」雙軌策略，紀律扣款並將股息滾入加碼，卡位第4季至明年第1季資金行情。（自立電子報2026/9/30）

news.Title: 00922集結50檔台股領袖 規模逼近千億
news.Content:
【記者柯安聰台北報導】全球AI競賽從晶片算力延伸至電力、散熱及資料中心建置，台灣企業在供應鏈的關鍵角色更加鮮明，國泰台灣領袖50（00922）聚焦50檔領袖級台股企業，持股涵蓋台積電、聯發科、台達電、鴻海及日月光投控，串聯晶片設計、先進製程、封裝測試到伺服器與電源散熱。這項跨環節配置特色，促使00922基金規模比2025年底成長118.02%、增逾1倍的重要觀察亮點。基金採每年2次收益分配，今日官網已發重要公告，本次參與配息最後申購日為10月16日，10月19日除息，預定11月12日發放。

除了科技供應鏈，00922同時涵蓋富邦金、中信金等金融企業，擴大參與台灣大型企業的發展。國內13家金控今年前8月獲利創新高，合計稅後獲利達5789.07億元，刷下歷年同期新高紀錄，也讓金融產業的營運表現成為台股另一項觀察重點。科技與金融的兩大支柱，可望為00922再添助攻動能。（自立電子報2026/9/30）

news.Title: AI spending will fuel wins for Micron, Nvidia, Intel, and other chip stocks: BofA analyst
news.Content:
We are down to three months left in the year, and on Wall Street, that means the start of year-ahead predictions for the economy, stocks, and sectors.

It's not unusual for analysts' big calls to drive the stocks they call out, especially if the calls are assigned to price targets and earnings estimate lifts.

Here's one of the first worthwhile look-ahead calls to hit our inbox, from BofA semiconductor analyst Vivek Arya on momentum tech stocks of companies at the center of the AI boom.

Arya pointed out the strong potential for AI capital expenditures to come in ahead of many estimates and be a better-than-expected tailwind for a host of stocks.

The call

On the outlook for AI infrastructure, Arya said, "We raise our CY26-30 estimate AI data center systems addressable market to $2.2 trillion at a +40% annual pace from $1.8 trillion/+33% prior. The virtuous flywheel of agentic tool adoption by consumers and enterprises, competition between public and private AI labs, and limited chip supply will likely keep AI spending robust for the next several years. Any pacing or addition of safety guardrails to frontier models is likely to increase not reduce compute requirements and shift more demand to faster growing inference from training. Meanwhile, valuations for top chip stocks remain compelling relative to their projected EPS growth, with SOX trading at a 21x forward PE, 12% below its 24x median multiple since the onset of ChatGPT and well below 40%+ projected EPS growth potential."

The stock winners

A host of stocks have bullish setups within Arya's revised AI thesis.

"Historically, CQ4 (and CQ1) have been the two best seasonal quarters to own chip stocks, with 300-500 basis of median outperformance vs. SPX from 2010-25," Arya wrote. "Our top picks with near-term catalysts include: 1) Nvidia ( NVDA ) (enhanced buybacks, multiple GTC tradeshow events), 2) Intel ( INTC ) (agentic CPU strength, foundry win anticipation), 3) Micron ( MU ) (start of buybacks from Dec-9), 4) Marvell ( MRVL ) (Analyst Day on Oct 6, XPU ramp) and 5) Lam Research ( LRCX ) (share gain potential across memory, logic). We also continue to like AMD ( AMD ), Applied Materials ( AMAT ), Analog Devices ( ADI ) and On Semiconductor ( ON ). Staying watchful on Broadcom ( AVGO ) where we are Buy-rated on compelling valuation with potential for enhanced buybacks when the company reports FQ4 in December."

另從進榜檔數來看，台新、中信投信2家突出，分別進榜2檔最多，台新投信量化投資團隊表示，台新00904、00947等2檔ETF雖然同樣聚焦台灣半導體產業，但投資定位各有特色，台新00904鎖定台灣半導體完整產業鏈，投資範圍涵蓋晶圓製造、IC設計、封裝測試、記憶體及半導體設備等領域；台新00947則進一步聚焦IC設計與高成長科技族群，掌握AI運算、ASIC、記憶體、邊緣運算及高速傳輸等科技趨勢，2檔產品形成「全產業鏈+IC設計」的雙主軸布局。

台新00947臺灣IC設計ETF經理人黃鈺民表示，台股持續受惠AI基建潮，加上Meta AI助理新推出，代理式AI新升浪推波助瀾、加速Q4旺季行情有影，建議投資人漲時重勢，除個股操作外，也可鎖定台股高彈力ETF，掌握第4季AI旺季催財機會，尤其是Meta新推出AI代理工具Muse在美國爆火，初步展現消費型態的代理式AI有成功跡象，引爆市場重新點燃對伺服器中央處理器(CPU)、記憶體及AI基礎設施需求的期待，推動台廠IC設計、記憶體族群中長期潛力看漲，股價大添柴火，後勁可期。

台新投信建議，在2027年美股企業獲利持續成長與AI需求穩健擴張下，提供高技術門檻、高訂單能見度與高產業競爭優勢的台廠半導體鏈，直接進入全球AI超級週期的全盛時代，建議投資人第4季可以長線布局季配息半導體ETF，除鎖定IC設計+記憶體為主的臺灣IC設計ETF外，亦另可搭配臺灣半導體全產業型ETF，雙管齊下打造半導體資產的「強強組合」，搭配兩類ETF每季配息收益，不僅完整捕捉代理式AI興起下的新一輪牛市爆發潛力，還享有息利雙收，作為追求長線財富增值的最佳現金流工具。（自立電子報2026/9/30）

news.Title: Alphabet vs. Meta Platforms: Which Media Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
news.Content:
Tech giants are evolving as artificial intelligence transforms the advertising market. Deciding whether to buy Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) (NASDAQ:GOOG) or Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) requires looking at their infrastructure and massive social reach.

Alphabet dominates search and cloud infrastructure, while Meta controls the world's largest social media network. Both companies rely on advertising dollars but serve different roles in the digital economy, making them frequent rivals for investor capital. Choosing between them depends on your preference for search dominance versus social engagement.

The case for Alphabet

Alphabet generates over 70% of its revenue from online advertising, with customers consisting of advertisers, digital publishers, and content providers. It also manages significant long-duration cloud services and infrastructure leasing contracts. This diverse base helps the company maintain a dominant position across various technology sectors.

In FY 2025, revenue reached nearly $402.8 billion, representing growth of approximately 15.1%. Net income grew to about $132.2 billion as net margin, a measure of profitability after all expenses, reached roughly 32.8%.

As of its December 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio is close to 0.1x, which measures total debt against shareholder equity. The current ratio, measuring the ability to pay short-term debts, is approximately 2.0x. Free cash flow reached roughly $73.3 billion, representing the cash remaining after paying for capital assets.

The case for Meta Platforms

Meta generates substantially all of its revenue from advertising on Facebook and Instagram, serving marketers and businesses that reach consumers. The company also partners with developers and relies on content creators to fuel its family of apps. Meta is a leader among communication stocks by connecting billions of people.

In FY 2025, revenue grew to roughly $201.0 billion, a significant increase of approximately 22.2% over the previous year. Net income reached close to $60.5 billion, and the company maintained a net margin of roughly 30.1% as it scaled its operations.

According to its December 2025 balance sheet, Meta carries a debt-to-equity ratio of nearly 0.4x. Its current ratio is approximately 2.6x, indicating a strong ability to cover near-term liabilities. Free cash flow for the year was roughly $46.1 billion, providing ample capital for its Reality Labs and artificial intelligence projects.

Risk profile comparison

Alphabet faces ongoing regulatory and antitrust litigation that could restrict how it distributes search services and require data sharing. It also deals with intense competition in artificial intelligence from various tech rivals and potential margin pressure from high-cost infrastructure investments. High operational risks related to data privacy and cybersecurity remain central to its business model.

Story Continues

Meta recently dealt with a historic $17 billion settlement concerning child safety that mandates structural reforms on its platforms. It faces high competitive threats from TikTok and must navigate privacy changes by Apple that impact its ad targeting effectiveness. Its performance remains sensitive to user engagement trends and the success of its capital-intensive investments in the metaverse.

Valuation comparison

Alphabet is cheaper by Forward P/E , comparing price to future earnings estimates, while Meta has a lower P/S ratio using sales over the past twelve months.

Which stock would I buy in 2026?

When it comes to choosing between Alphabet and Meta, investors should probably lean toward the Google parent.

Admittedly, as Magnificent Seven stocks, both are likely to outperform the market over time. Still, Alphabet appears to have a more certain business model for AI.

That stands in contrast to Meta, which has relied on ad revenue and attracting more users to grow revenue. However, at 3.6 billion daily users, Meta is running out of new users to pursue. Also, much like Alphabet, Meta anticipates that digital ad growth will eventually slow.

Moreover, while Meta may succeed in leveraging its treasure trove of data to train AI models in a way no other company could, it has yet to prove the success of this strategy.

In contrast, Google Gemini is among the more popular AI assistants. Moreover, its massive capex spending seems to have spawned accelerated revenue growth. Assuming Waymo can start generating meaningful revenue, its growth could accelerate.

Ultimately, when also considering its lower P/E ratio, Alphabet seems to stand out among the two companies.
